analysis:
Examined MediaIngestTests.swift base (1-815) and head (1-672). Per the complete range map, the only changes are six pattern-match sites (head lines 118, 185, 209, 227, 533 and 766). These now match `.source` on the values returned by decodeImage, decodeImageData and decodeVideo instead of matching the returned enum directly. This implies the production return type changed to a wrapper struct containing a `source` field, perhaps with added metadata. That production change is not in this batch.

All security-relevant tests remain unchanged:
- SSRF and file:// rejection: lines 132-144 and 324-336.
- No plaintext temp file and in-memory video: lines 196-221 (T-050).
- Narrow legacy temp purge: lines 234-255.
- Fail-closed video MIME/probe checks: lines 290-322.
- Decompression-bomb byte, pixel, count and aggregate caps: lines 519-815.

The tests still assert `.memoryBacked`, so the T-050 no-disk guarantee remains locked in at the test level. No test-side regression was found.

Integration should check the production MediaIngest wrapper type for:
1. Whether the new field alongside `source` carries prompt-derived data (A-001) into logs, cache keys or the prefix-cache salt or metadata (T-041). Examples would be image hashes or dimensions.
2. Whether buildUserInput still enforces aggregate caps on the wrapper.
3. Whether any path can still construct a non-memory-backed or `.url` source.
